description: Runs the real ingest -> normalize chain against fixtures/boms/orcad_bom.csv, an OrCAD/Allegro-style ad-hoc report with a 4-line title block above the real header (header_row_index=4 per the M1 fixture). Once the header is found, the same passive/connector/LED unresolved pattern as the other three exports holds for the confidently-classifiable rows; U1's outcome is deliberately left unscored for the same reason as eagle_bom's U1 (its Description 'Dual Op-Amp' is hyphenated the same way, but footprint resolution for 'SOIC8' was not independently traced).
not_extended_to: expand/source/policy/evaluate/plan/export -- no fixtures/catalogs/ snapshot exists for orcad_bom.csv's parts, and none of the confidently-scored rows resolve fully anyway.
hand_verified_reasoning:
orcad_bom.csv data rows (after the 4-line title block; row_index per orcad_bom.expected.json, header_row_index=4):
- row 0 (R1-R4, Value '10k', Description 'Resistor'): refdes 'R' -> RESISTOR confident. resistance parses. No tolerance stated anywhere -> guaranteed parameters.tolerance_pct.
- row 1 (R5, '4k7', 'Resistor'): identical -> guaranteed parameters.tolerance_pct.
- row 2 (C1-C2, '100nF', 'Capacitor'): refdes 'C' -> CAPACITOR confident. capacitance parses. No voltage/dielectric stated -> guaranteed parameters.voltage_rating + parameters.dielectric.
- row 3 (U1, Value empty, Description 'Dual Op-Amp'): same hyphenated-'Op-Amp' match as eagle_bom's U1 -> likely category=IC_ANALOG (no required parameters), contingent on 'SOIC8' footprint resolution not independently traced here -> deliberately excluded from every guaranteed tally, same as eagle_bom's row 5.
- row 4 (J1, Value empty, Description 'Connector 4-pin header'): refdes 'J' -> CONNECTOR confident, independent of description. No pin_count-populating code path -> guaranteed parameters.pin_count.
- row 5 (D1, Value empty, Description 'LED Red'): refdes 'D' -> DIODE from prefix, description keyword 'led' specializes to LED, confident. Neither forward_voltage nor forward_current stated -> guaranteed parameters.forward_voltage + parameters.forward_current.
Tally: rows 0,1,2,4,5 are guaranteed unresolved (5 of 6); row 3 is the sole row not scored either way -> unresolved_min=5. category_counts_guaranteed: resistor={0,1}=2, capacitor={2}=1, connector={4}=1, led={5}=1; row 3 (U1) omitted for the same documented reason as eagle_bom's U1.
